Name: Shimei, Son of Libni
Summary: Son of Libni and father of Uzza in Merari's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:29: Son of Libni and father of Uzza in Merari's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Shimei stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
